rationale.conceptual: The task uses established DFT methods (PBE+U, spin-polarized calculations, supercell magnetisation) but requires careful handling of magnetic ordering, Hubbard U parameters, and analysis of half-metallic behaviour and mean-field Curie temperatures. It is a non-trivial, multi-part computational protocol that demands domain knowledge in electronic structure theory.
rationale.execution: The pipeline comprises four distinct stages: building structures, geometry optimisation, static energy calculations for three magnetic configurations, and electronic structure analysis. This involves multiple DFT runs per TM, handling of output files, and assembly of results. It is a moderate orchestration (4–6 effective stages) with standard tooling (ASE, GPAW/QE).
